title: String Permutations
description: Write a Zig program that generates all permutations of a 3-character string using recursion.
verificationTest: output.includes('ABC') && output.includes('ACB') && output.includes('BAC') && output.includes('BCA') && output.includes('CAB') && output.includes('CBA')
hints: Use backtracking: swap, recurse, swap back to restore original state
The base case is when left == right — print the permutation
Pass the array as `[]u8` (a mutable slice) for in-place swaps
